items.title: Coventry need to 'keep feet on the ground' after 'landmark' win - Lampard
items.summary: Frank Lampard reacts to Coventry's "landmark" day after they earned their first top flight win in 25 years, beating Nottingham Forest 1-0 at the City Ground in the Premier League.
